about_the_game:
Escape to a cozy pixel world where you can farm, fish, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Grow over 20 different crops, chop trees, and mine for resources. Get to know several unique NPCs, each with their own backstory, quests, and mysteries to uncover.

The game is designed to be enjoyed at your own pace. Whether you want to min-max your earnings and climb the gold-earned leaderboard, or simply enjoy the soundtrack and search for easter eggs hidden around the island. Build your farm, meet unique NPCs, and shape your own adventure at a relaxing pace.

The game was solo developed by me, including the soundtrack.

  • Grow and harvest a variety of crops

  • Relax with fishing, mining, woodcutting, questing

  • Figure out the best ways to earn gold and compete on the leaderboard

  • Interact with NPCs to uncover the story of the island

  • Work hard to upgrade your skills and equipment… and maybe even leave the island

  • Compatible with Windows, Mac, and Steam Deck

short_description: Build your dream farm in a cozy pixel RPG. Grow crops, fish, mine, and explore a charming island full of secrets. Meet unique NPCs, craft and trade items, and uncover magical surprises at your own pace. Relax, explore, and create your story in this farming adventure.
